profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); mildly restrictive on security; pro-transparency
summary: Marikina 1st District representative with about 96 principal-authored bills. Authored a Magna Carta for barangay health workers, a higher social pension, free child medical and dental services, HMO cover for teachers, a higher income-tax threshold, a right-to-information act, participatory budgeting, mandatory CCTV, detention contraband control and a cybercrime harassment bill. Also authored fixed terms for barangay and SK officials.
caveat: The barangay and SK term-fixing bills (HB10807, HB10971) were not read; if they extend terms, the democratic score would drop. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored higher social pension (-3), Magna Carta for barangay health workers and free child medical and dental care (-2), HMO cover for teachers; co-authored minimum wage (-2) and a solidarity contribution on the affluent (-3). Tax threshold and micro-business MCIT exemption mild. Four issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB10588, HB01254, HB10950, HB10952, HB10462, HB10464; co-author HB00094, HB04304 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored mandatory CCTV installation for crime deterrence (-2), stronger contraband control in detention facilities (-1) and cybercrime-act strengthening against harassment (-1). Public-safety framing; titles only. Three issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01259, HB04448, HB10635 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored strengthening of the right to information (+3) and a national participatory budgeting system (+3), discounted to +2 because the barangay and SK term-fixing bills were not read and could be negative. Two issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04451, HB07990; HB10807, HB10971 not scored (retrieved 2026-11-01)
